claims.text: Turing's 1936 paper 'On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem' introduced an abstract machine consisting of an infinite tape, a read/write head and a finite table of rules.
claims.textZh: 1936 年的论文《On Computable Numbers…》提出了一种抽象机器，由无限长的纸带、读写头和有限规则表组成

sources.title: A. M. Turing, On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem, Proc. London Math. Soc. s2-42 (1936–37)

claims.text: The same paper proves that a 'universal machine' exists: given the description of another machine, it can simulate that machine.
claims.textZh: 同一篇论文证明存在"通用机"：读入另一台机器的描述，就能模拟那台机器

sources.title: A. M. Turing, On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem, Proc. London Math. Soc. s2-42 (1936–37)

claims.text: In 1936 there was not yet an electronic general-purpose computer in the modern sense.
claims.textZh: 1936 年还没有现代意义上的电子通用计算机

sources.title: Standard account in the history of computing

claims.text: Turing was born on 23 June 1912 and was 23–24 years old in 1936.

sources.title: Andrew Hodges, Alan Turing: The Enigma

claims.text: What modern computers can compute does not exceed what a Turing machine can compute.
claims.textZh: 现代计算机能计算的东西，不超出图灵机的能力范围
claims.notes: 这是理论共识的通俗说法，不要写成"手机就是图灵机"

claims.text: During the Second World War, from September 1939, Turing worked on codebreaking at Bletchley Park.
claims.textZh: 二战期间，图灵从 1939 年 9 月起在布莱切利园从事密码破译

sources.title: Andrew Hodges, Alan Turing: The Enigma

claims.text: Turing led the design of the Bombe used to break Enigma.
claims.textZh: 图灵主导设计了用于破解恩尼格玛的 Bombe

sources.title: Andrew Hodges, Alan Turing: The Enigma

claims.notes: 它基于波兰的 bomba，Welchman 后来加入了对角板改进。写"主导设计"，不写"独自发明"

claims.text: This work stayed secret for a long time; the Ultra secret only began to be made public from 1974, about 20 years after his death.
claims.textZh: 这些工作长期保密，1974 年起 Ultra 计划才开始公开，距他去世约 20 年

sources.title: F. W. Winterbotham, The Ultra Secret (1974)

claims.text: Turing's 1950 paper in Mind opens with: I propose to consider the question, 'Can machines think?'
claims.textZh: 1950 年论文发表于 Mind 59(236): 433–460，开头句为 "I propose to consider the question, 'Can machines think?'"

claims.text: The paper proposes the 'imitation game': an interrogator communicates only by typing with an unseen human and an unseen machine, then judges which is which.
claims.textZh: 论文提出"模仿游戏"：提问者只通过打字，与看不见的一人一机交流，然后做出判断

sources.title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence, Mind 59(236): 433-460, sections 1–2

claims.notes: 原文建议在两个房间之间用电传打字机通信

claims.text: In its section on learning machines, the paper proposes simulating a child's mind rather than an adult's, and then subjecting it to education.
claims.textZh: 论文"学习机器"一节提出：与其模拟成年人的头脑，不如模拟孩子的头脑，再对它施以教育

sources.title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence, Mind 59(236): 433-460, section 7

claims.notes: 旁白是意译，画面上不出现这句原文

claims.text: The paper's last sentence is "We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done."
claims.textZh: 论文最后一句为 "We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done."

claims.text: In 1952 Turing was convicted of 'gross indecency' for homosexual acts and accepted probation conditional on hormone treatment; he did not go to prison.
claims.textZh: 1952 年，他因同性行为以"严重猥亵罪"被定罪，接受了以激素治疗为条件的缓刑，没有入狱

sources.title: Andrew Hodges, Alan Turing: The Enigma

claims.text: Turing died at his home in Wilmslow on 7 June 1954, aged 41.
claims.textZh: 1954 年 6 月 7 日，他在位于威姆斯洛的家中去世，享年 41 岁

sources.title: Andrew Hodges, Alan Turing: The Enigma

claims.notes: 不写死因（见规格第 6 节）

claims.text: The term 'artificial intelligence' first appeared in the Dartmouth research proposal of 31 August 1955.
claims.textZh: "artificial intelligence" 一词首次出现在 1955 年 8 月 31 日的达特茅斯研究提案中

sources.title: J. McCarthy, M. L. Minsky, N. Rochester, C. E. Shannon, A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence (1955)

claims.notes: "首次出现"是通行说法；如果核验时发现争议，改为"正式出现在一份研究提案里"
